findings.title: httpx used but not declared as dependency
findings.problem: test_client.py does `import httpx` directly and uses `httpx.AsyncClient`, but pyproject.toml's `dependencies` array does not list httpx; it is available only because a2a-sdk/langchain-openai currently pull it in transitively.
findings.impact: If a future a2a-sdk or langchain-openai version stops depending on httpx, `uv run test_client.py` breaks with ImportError even though httpx is used directly here; the two sibling agents (research-agent, currency_converter) both declare `httpx>=0.28.1` explicitly, so this is also inconsistent with the repo's own established convention.
findings.recommendation: Add "httpx>=0.28.1" to text-insights-agent/pyproject.toml's dependencies array, matching research-agent and currency_converter.
